title: Hook events: prompts and message display
description: Event arrays (`hookEvent_<Event>`) and matcher groups (`hookMatcherGroup_<Event>`) for: UserPromptSubmit, UserPromptExpansion, MessageDisplay.

hookEvent_UserPromptSubmit.title: UserPromptSubmit
hookEvent_UserPromptSubmit.description: When the user submits a prompt, before Claude processes it. Default command/http/mcp_tool timeout is 30 s.

hookMatcherGroup_UserPromptSubmit.description: Matcher group for UserPromptSubmit: an optional matcher plus the handlers to run when it applies. Handlers allowed here: command, http, mcp_tool, prompt or agent. The `if` field is not evaluated on this event, so a handler that sets it never runs.

matcher.description: UserPromptSubmit has no matcher support: the field is accepted but silently ignored and the group fires on every occurrence. Omit it.
matcher.title: Matcher

hooks.description: Hook handlers to run when the matcher applies; all matching handlers run in parallel and identical handlers from several settings files run once.
hooks.title: Hooks

hookEvent_UserPromptExpansion.title: UserPromptExpansion
hookEvent_UserPromptExpansion.description: When a user-typed command expands into a prompt, before it reaches Claude. Can block the expansion.

hookMatcherGroup_UserPromptExpansion.description: Matcher group for UserPromptExpansion: an optional matcher plus the handlers to run when it applies. Handlers allowed here: command, http, mcp_tool, prompt or agent. The `if` field is not evaluated on this event, so a handler that sets it never runs.

matcher.description: Filters on the command name (skill or command name). Evaluation: `*`, an empty string, or an omitted matcher matches everything; a value made only of letters, digits, `_`, `-`, spaces, `,` and `|` is an exact string or a `|`/`,`-separated list of exact strings; any other character makes it an unanchored JavaScript regular expression (RegExp.test).
matcher.title: Matcher

hooks.description: Hook handlers to run when the matcher applies; all matching handlers run in parallel and identical handlers from several settings files run once.
hooks.title: Hooks

hookEvent_MessageDisplay.title: MessageDisplay
hookEvent_MessageDisplay.description: While assistant message text is displayed. Display-only. Default command/http/mcp_tool timeout is 10 s.

hookMatcherGroup_MessageDisplay.description: Matcher group for MessageDisplay: an optional matcher plus the handlers to run when it applies. Handlers allowed here: command, http or mcp_tool (prompt and agent hooks are not supported on this event). The `if` field is not evaluated on this event, so a handler that sets it never runs.

matcher.description: MessageDisplay has no matcher support: the field is accepted but silently ignored and the group fires on every occurrence. Omit it.
matcher.title: Matcher

hooks.description: Hook handlers to run when the matcher applies; all matching handlers run in parallel and identical handlers from several settings files run once.
hooks.title: Hooks
